title: Naturality of normalized total-tensor evaluation
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W and n≥0. On the ringed coefficient sequence site [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], let e_n be evaluation and κ_n(P,Q):e_n Tot(P,Q)≅Tot(e_nP,e_nQ) the specified generator-normalized comparison [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. For every pair of chain maps a:P→P′ and b:Q→Q′ of arbitrary unbounded sequence-module complexes, e_n(Tot(a,b)) followed by κ_n(P′,Q′) equals κ_n(P,Q) followed by Tot(e_na,e_nb), as cochain maps over the nth quotient ring.

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; Tag 0941, the ringed sequence site

proof.text: Precompose with κ_n(P,Q) inverse. Test degree k on all pure-tensor generators using total_pure_hom_ext. The prescribed normalization and the inverse isomorphism identity identify the inverse image of each evaluated pure tensor with the corresponding tensor of sequence sections.

The map of a tensor complex sends each total pure generator to the generator of the two mapped factors. Apply this before and after evaluation, then use the forward normalization of κ_n(P′,Q′). Both routes agree on every generator, proving the naturality square.
